parsed.explanation: GE adopted ASU 2018-12 on January 1, 2023, with a modified retrospective transition date of January 1, 2021, which caused prior-period insurance liability balances to be restated, altering the reported 2021 net income figure between the two filings.
parsed.evidence_quote: The new guidance for measuring the liability for future policy benefits and related reinsurance recoverable asset was adopted on a modified retrospective basis such that those balances were adjusted to conform to the new guidance at the January 1, 2021 transition date.
